runs.text: America, judged like Israel. Ready? Official report. Finding one: America is stolen land. Native nations were here first, for thousands of years. Today there are five hundred and seventy four federally recognized tribes. Finding two: annexation. In eighteen forty eight, Mexico gave up fifty five percent of its territory. California included. Finding three: Puerto Ricans are American citizens. They can't vote for president. Neither can Guam. Finding four: a wall. About seven hundred and six miles on the Mexican border. Finding five: miles, pounds and Fahrenheit. The occupation of the metric system. Sounds ridiculous? Israel hears it every day. America isn't an apartheid state. Neither is Israel, where one in five citizens is Arab. Both have real problems. One standard. Same test, from the top.
